name: ParticipantTile

component.name: ParticipantTile
component.description: Displays one participant's video with a name tag. When their video is off, or renderVideo is false, shows their name and name tag instead.

props.name: participant
props.description: Participant to display. Use the Participant type exported by this package.

props.name: width
props.description: Tile width in pixels. The name text scales with the tile width.

props.name: height
props.description: Fallback tile height in pixels, used only when aspectRatio is 0. Otherwise the height is width divided by aspectRatio (16/9 by default).

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Tile width-to-height ratio. The tile height is width divided by this ratio.

props.name: videoQuality
props.description: Requested video quality for this participant. VideoQuality comes from @zoom/videosdk.

props.name: isActive
props.description: Highlights the tile. Customize the highlight with activeClassName and activeStyle.

props.name: activeClassName
props.description: CSS class applied in place of the default active-tile class when isActive is true.

props.name: activeStyle
props.description: Inline style added to the tile when isActive is true.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS class for the tile.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the tile. The width and height props set the tile size and override any width or height in style.

props.name: customNameTag
props.description: Replaces the default name tag. By default, the tag shows the participant's name, with a phone icon for phone audio, or a muted-microphone icon when computer audio is muted. Before the participant joins audio, it shows a connecting indicator instead of the name. The video-off view also shows the participant's name on its own.

props.name: renderVideo
props.description: Whether to render the participant video. False shows the video-off presentation.

notes: When used on its own, ParticipantTile must be rendered inside a <video-player-container> element. Use one container for all video tiles, and don't put ShareTile components in it. VideoLayout and MobileVideoLayout provide this container for you.
Neither this package nor the Zoom Video SDK declares <video-player-container> as a JSX element. In TypeScript, add it to React's JSX.IntrinsicElements in your own declaration file.

types.name: Participant
types.description: Zoom Video SDK Participant type, also exported by this package.

types.name: VideoQuality
types.description: Video quality enum from the Zoom Video SDK. Import it with `import { VideoQuality } from '@zoom/videosdk'`.
types.definition: enum VideoQuality { Video_90P = 0, Video_180P = 1, Video_360P = 2, Video_720P = 3, Video_1080P = 4 }
